name: Anhui Jiangnan Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Jiangnan Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and production of civil explosives in China and internationally. It offers gel-like emulsion explosives, powdered emulsion explosives, expanded explosives, seismic source charges, detonating charges, industrial detonating cords, electronic detonators, ignition charges for airbags, and gas-generating charges for airbags. The company also provides blasting engineering design, assessment, supervision, testing, drilling, blasting, excavation, and transportation services.
